name: Resounding Voice
body:
School transmutation [sonic]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The touched target’s voice becomes magically enhanced. It is able to be heard clearly up to 100 feet away per caster level. This does not bypass areas of silence or deafness.

This spell counters and dispels silence on the target and is countered and dispelled by silence.
